notes: AOI [-25.0, 45.0, 34.0, 72.0]: spherical centroid 10.0000, 55.9188; spans 70 x 38 degrees (~4367 x 4202 km, square); property equal_area.
family: square region: laea on the AOI's spherical centroid.

rounded to 5 degree steps (lat_0 55.9188 -> 55, lon_0 10.0000 -> 10): max scale error 4.012% vs 4.120% exact; the coarsest step within 50% of exact, capped at 0.1 and floored at 0.01 percentage points. A rounded centre does better than the centroid: the centroid is not the minimax centre.
EPSG:3035 (ETRS89-extended / LAEA Europe) does as well over the AOI (3.705%), so the spec uses it.
domain: AOI's projected bounds padded 5% and snapped out to whole 512 px tiles at 100 m; tile_px 512 keeps every tile edge a whole metre at [100].
